title: Amouage Interlude Man Eau de Parfum 100ml
description:
Interlude Man is one of Amouage's most recognisable compositions, built around a dramatic contrast between herbal bitterness and deep resinous smoke. Bergamot, oregano and pimento berry open with a dry, crackling spice that reads almost savoury, before a heart of amber, frankincense, cistus and opoponax settles into something warmer and more meditative. The base of leather, agarwood smoke, patchouli and sandalwood gives the fragrance its dense, lasting signature.

Fragrance Notes

  • Top: Bergamot, oregano, pimento berry
  • Heart: Amber, frankincense, cistus, opoponax, vanilla
  • Base: Leather, agarwood smoke, patchouli, sandalwood

A woody amber fragrance for men, best suited to cool weather and evening wear where its smoky depth has room to unfold.

title: Amouage Interlude Black Iris Eau de Parfum 100ml

Bergamot, rosemary and violet leaf open cool and green, leading into a heart of orris, amber, frankincense, cistus, myrrh and vanilla. The familiar agarwood smoke, leather, patchouli and sandalwood base remains, but the iris gives it a rounded, almost chocolatey texture.

Fragrance Notes

  • Top: Bergamot, rosemary, violet leaf
  • Heart: Orris, amber, frankincense, cistus, myrrh, vanilla
  • Base: Leather, agarwood smoke, patchouli, sandalwood

A unisex Eau de Parfum that pairs iris elegance with a smoky, resinous core.

title: Amouage Beach Hut Man Eau de Parfum 100ml

  • Base: Patchouli, myrrh, dry woods

A men's Eau de Parfum that works particularly well in warm weather and daytime settings.

The base of ambergris, civet, musk, cedarwood and sandalwood gives it a warm, animalic richness that lingers.

  • Base: Ambergris, civet, musk, cedarwood, sandalwood

A women's Eau de Parfum with a full, ceremonial character for those who appreciate grand classical perfumery.

Gharam is a warm oriental with a spiced floral character. Saffron, rose and cinnamon open rich and warm, oud, patchouli and amber give a deep resinous heart, and vanilla, musk and sandalwood close smooth and woody.

Fragrance Notes

  • Top: Saffron, rose, cinnamon
  • Heart: Oud, patchouli, amber
  • Base: Vanilla, musk, sandalwood

A unisex Eau de Parfum from Lattafa Pride with an elegant oriental character.
